headline: How to breed the Dracula Dragon
title: How to Breed Dracula Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends | Void + Metal + Wind | DML Breeding Guide
video_script: Want the Dracula Dragon in Dragon Mania Legends? Breed two dragons that together carry the Void, Metal and Wind elements. No combination is guaranteed, so you may need a few tries. Tip: higher level and rarer parents give you better odds of a rare dragon. Which dragon should I cover next? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Higher level parents = better rare odds

description: Dragon Mania Legends: breed two dragons that together carry Void, Metal and Wind to get the Dracula Dragon. No combination is guaranteed. Element combos checked on the DML wiki and the TouchTapPlay breeding guide.
